'''Jarene''' is the eldest daughter of Queen [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]] and [[Brys Noramaga|Prince Brys]] of [[Kandor]].

== Appearances ==
She is lovely and has green eyes.{{ref/book|0|25}} 

==History==
She was born in {{ne|966}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jarene|Jarene}}

Moiraine meets her in {{ne|979}} when Jarene is twelve. At that time, she is in charge of her four younger brothers and younger sister while her older brother, [[Antol]], and her mother are in Southern Kandor. 

While her mother is away, her father and her brother [[Diryk]] are killed by [[Merean Redhill]] of the [[Black Ajah]].{{ref/book|0|25}}

She married a Kandori lord.{{ref||Jarene}}
